text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending maximum one-hour parking from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the east side of Hannaford Street, between Lyall Avenue and Kingston Road. The proposed regulation will discourage long-term daytime parking and promote parking turnover by non-residents on this section of Hannaford Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Hannaford Street, between Lyall Avenue and Kingston Road. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Hannaford Street, between a point 75 metres north of Kingston Road and a point 10 metres further north. 3. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Hannaford Street, between Gerrard Street East and Kingston Road.
